summary: US forces launched a second wave of attacks against Iran targeting military capabilities near the Strait of Hormuz. Israeli strikes destroyed four Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza and killed a Hamas sniper commander. Iranian air defenses activated in Tehran amid reported explosions near Parchin and Pakdasht.

IDF struck and destroyed four Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza containing Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades and explosives (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).
IDF killed Omar Ahmad Abu Qassem, a Hamas battalion sniper commander, in central Gaza Strip yesterday (Source: @almogboker78/17724).
Air defense activated in parts of Tehran with explosion sounds heard near Parchin and Pakdasht (Source: @shin_persian/7962).
Syrian Interior Ministry forces thwarted weapons smuggling of dozens of FPV drones and anti-tank missiles from Iraq via al-Tanf crossing (Source: @New_security8200/202658).
IDF 401st Brigade killed three armed Hezbollah militants in Beit Yahoun within the southern Lebanon security zone (Source: @idf_telegram/24649).
Israeli Air Force attacked Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon despite the ceasefire (Source: @presstv/199008).
US approved $2.5bn in arms sales to Saudi Arabia and Kuwait amid aggression against Iran (Source: @presstv/199007).

sections.executive_summary: US forces launched a second wave of attacks against Iran targeting military capabilities near the Strait of Hormuz. Israeli strikes destroyed four Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza and killed a Hamas sniper commander. Iranian air defenses activated in Tehran amid reported explosions near Parchin and Pakdasht.

points: US forces began a second wave of attacks on Iran at 3pm US Eastern time (22:30 Tehran time) targeting Iranian military capabilities used to threaten ships in the Strait of Hormuz, a vital international waterway for global trade (Source: @VahidOnline/77126).

Air defense activated in parts of Tehran with explosion sounds reportedly heard near Parchin and Pakdasht; assessment of the incident is ongoing according to an IRGC-linked media outlet (Source: @shin_persian/7962).
An attack occurred at Parchin with air defense activated, according to a channel report (Source: @kianmeli1/89205).
Explosions were reported in Ahvaz in southwestern Iran by local reports (Source: @inon_yttach/9490). A separate message reported a US attack in Ahvaz (Source: @lelotsenzura/93623).
Reports state US attacked Semnan airport in northern Iran overnight; the area hosts a large IRGC missile base (Source: @asafroz/51509).

Explosion sounds were reported in Urmia from surrounding mountains and from near the border, with a missile launched from Esko in East Azerbaijan; a missile was also reported fired from Tabriz at 3:46 (Source: @VahidOnline/77137).

Earlier messages from Chabahar in Sistan and Baluchestan (Ahmad Riza post, Bahar town, Ramin road) reported hearing several explosions coinciding with start of US attacks (Source: @VahidOnline/77129).

IDF struck and destroyed four Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza overnight containing Kalashnikov rifles, RPGs, grenades, explosive devices and other military equipment intended for attacks on troops (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).

IDF killed Omar Ahmad Abu Qassem, a Hamas battalion sniper commander in the Hamas military wing, in central Gaza Strip yesterday; he had tried to rebuild Hamas's military wing and promoted terror plots against IDF (Source: @almogboker78/17724).

Border Police undercover unit (Yamam) with Shin Bet intelligence, Jerusalem Border Police, Binyamin Border Police and IDF Etzion Brigade arrested a wanted terrorist suspect in al-Eizariya in Etzion Brigade sector (Source: @New_security8200/202654).

Israeli Air Force attacked Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon near Ali Tahir ridge, according to Lebanese reports (Source: @yediotnews25/132776). Another report says IAF attacked a terror target in Nabatieh, south Lebanon (Source: @New_security8200/202668).

IDF 401st Brigade killed three armed Hezbollah militants in Beit Yahoun within the southern Lebanon security zone after detection by 869th Divisional Reconnaissance Battalion under 91st Division (Source: @idf_telegram/24649).
Israel is stepping up a campaign to hunt and kill every Oct. 7 terrorist despite the Gaza truce (Source: @manniefabian/58795).

IDF struck and destroyed four Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza overnight; the facilities stored Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades, explosive devices and other military equipment for attacks on IDF troops in the yellow line area (Source: @manniefabian/58796).

IDF killed Omar Ahmad Abu Qassem, a Hamas battalion sniper commander, in central Gaza Strip yesterday; he participated in terror plots against IDF forces and violated the ceasefire agreement (Source: @inon_yttach/9494).

Border Police undercover unit with Shin Bet, Jerusalem Border Police, Binyamin Border Police and Etzion Brigade forces arrested a wanted suspect involved in terror activity in al-Eizariya village in the Etzion Brigade sector (Source: @New_security8200/202654).
The IDF states forces in Southern Command are deployed in the Gaza area per the agreement and will continue to remove any threat (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).
Israeli forces continued airstrikes targeting the town of Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon despite the ceasefire (Source: @presstv/199008).
Israeli Air Force attacked Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon near the Ali Tahar mountain slope, per Lebanese reports (Source: @yediotnews25/132776).
Israeli warplanes flew toward Lebanon; maximum caution urged (Source: @redlinkleb/31495). Warplanes also flew over the south with maximum caution warning (Source: @redlinkleb/31475).

IDF 401st Brigade killed three armed Hezbollah militants carrying combat equipment in Beit Yahoun within the southern Lebanon security zone after 869th Recon Battalion detected them (Source: @idf_telegram/24649).

Airstrike reported on Nabatieh Al-Fawqa (Source: @redlinkleb/31514). Artillery shelling reported from Rshaf hours earlier (Source: @redlinkleb/31530). Drone strike reported at Ali al-Tahar an hour earlier (Source: @redlinkleb/31528).
Israeli Air Force attacked a terror target in Nabatieh, south Lebanon, per Lebanese reports (Source: @New_security8200/202668).

Syrian Interior Ministry security forces thwarted a weapons smuggling attempt including dozens of FPV explosive drones and dozens of anti-tank missiles hidden in a fuel truck moving from Iraq to Syria via al-Tanf crossing (Source: @New_security8200/202658).
The weapons intercepted at al-Tanf were reportedly destined for Hezbollah in Lebanon which used FPV drones extensively in recent months (Source: @New_security8200/202658).

Iraqi Joint Operations Command formed a high committee after the weapons interception to coordinate with Syria and hold negligent parties accountable for border security (Source: @naya_foriraq/83388).
A drone fell on a tanker outside Iraqi ports' scope; unloading and handling operations continue without stop (Source: @naya_foriraq/83384).
Oil exports at Basra port were temporarily halted after an oil tanker was targeted by a drone (Source: @shin_persian/7965).
Iranians hit the US embassy in Iraq, per a channel report (Source: @lelotsenzura/93619).
US attacked Semnan airport in northern Iran overnight; area hosts large IRGC missile base (Source: @asafroz/51509).
The United States approved nearly $2.5 billion in new arms sales to Saudi Arabia and Kuwait as it presses military aggression against Iran (Source: @presstv/199007).
Jordan reported an aerial attack with 8 rockets targeting Jordanian territory (Source: @naya_foriraq/83357).
US early-warning aircraft flew intensively over Aqaba, Jordan (Source: @naya_foriraq/83356).
Iran threatened to activate the Houthis to close the Bab al-Mandeb strait if the US attacks power stations, per Reuters (Source: @pkpoi/143317).
An agreement between Iran and Ansar Allah (Houthis) to close Bab al-Mandeb if the US targets energy facilities was reported by Reuters (Source: @naya_foriraq/83387).
The Saudi ambassador in Lebanon is distributing tempting money to Lebanese officials and figures to buy their positions against Hezbollah, per Abdulmalik al-Houthi (Source: @naya_foriraq/83396).

key_developments: US forces launched a second wave of attacks on Iran at 22:30 Tehran time targeting military capabilities threatening free passage of ships through the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @VahidOnline/77126).
IDF destroyed four Hamas weapon depots in central Gaza overnight containing Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades and explosives meant for attacks on troops (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).
Air defense activated in parts of Tehran with explosions heard near Parchin and Pakdasht per IRGC-linked media, assessment ongoing (Source: @shin_persian/7962).
Syrian forces thwarted smuggling of dozens of FPV drones and anti-tank missiles from Iraq via al-Tanf crossing destined for Hezbollah (Source: @New_security8200/202658).
IDF 401st Brigade killed three armed Hezbollah militants in Beit Yahoun security zone after 869th Recon Battalion detection (Source: @idf_telegram/24649).
Israeli airstrikes hit Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire, per Press TV and Lebanese reports (Source: @presstv/199008).
US approved $2.5bn arms packages for Saudi Arabia and Kuwait amid aggression against Iran (Source: @presstv/199007).
sections.threat_assessment: US attacks on Iran including a second wave targeting Strait of Hormuz capabilities significantly raise the risk of Iranian retaliation via proxies. Iran's reported threat to activate Houthis against Bab al-Mandeb and the drone strike on a Basra oil tanker show widening maritime threats. Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon continue to generate localized armed engagement with Hamas and Hezbollah. Syrian interdiction of FPV drones and AT missiles bound for Hezbollah indicates active smuggling corridors from Iraq.
sections.regional_response: Jordan reported an 8-rocket aerial attack on its territory and US early-warning aircraft flew over Aqaba, signaling heightened alert post-US-Iran escalation. Saudi Arabia and Kuwait received $2.5bn in US arms amid the aggression against Iran. Iraq formed a high committee with Syria after weapons interception to secure borders. The Saudi ambassador in Lebanon was accused by Houthis of buying positions against Hezbollah, reflecting regional polarization.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple Iranian locations reported explosions: Ahvaz, Semnan airport (IRGC missile base), Urmia, Tabriz, Chabahar, Parchin and Pakdasht near Tehran. CENTCOM explicitly tied strikes to Hormuz freedom of navigation. IDF continues truce-violating targeted killings and depot destruction in Gaza citing threat removal. Lebanese reports of repeated Nabatieh strikes suggest sustained IAF campaign despite ceasefire. Weapons flow from Iraq through al-Tanf to Hezbollah remains a tracked vector.
